bodyDescription: This delicious paté treat made with chicken is a veritable delicacy for every cat!The natural ingredients are steamed so that the nutritious properties are well preserved. Cleaning and preparing the chicken, filling cans and adding toppings are all done manually. This delicious gluten-free sardine-based paté treat is a real treat for any cat !
